plan.objective: Identify concrete taxonomy defects in cache.py with exact category and line evidence, focusing on cache key correctness and related runtime concerns.

steps.description: Read cache.py to capture exact line numbers and the full body of the price() function and module-level cache dict.
steps.success_criterion: Numbered source lines for the cache dict and price() function are retrieved.

steps.description: Analyze cache_py_source_lines for incorrect_cache_key: cache keyed on product_id only while value depends on currency.
steps.success_criterion: A decision recorded with the exact line of the cache lookup/store and whether currency is excluded from the key.

steps.description: Analyze cache_py_source_lines for concurrency/state defects in the check-then-set cache pattern (race_condition) and for unawaited coroutine if fetch is async (missing_await).
steps.success_criterion: Each of race_condition and missing_await is confirmed or rejected with cited line numbers.

steps.description: Run the linter on cache.py to surface any mutable_default, null_dereference, or swallowed_exception signals with line references.
steps.success_criterion: Linter completes and its diagnostics (or absence thereof) are recorded with line numbers.

steps.description: Run the test suite for cache.py to observe behavior across differing currencies for the same product_id.
steps.success_criterion: Tests execute and pass/fail outcomes relevant to currency-dependent caching are recorded.

steps.description: Synthesize cache_key_finding, concurrency_finding, linter_report, and test_results into a final defect list restricted to the frozen taxonomy, each with category and line evidence.
steps.success_criterion: Every reported defect has one taxonomy category and a specific line number; unsupported candidates are excluded.

plan.completion_criterion: final_defect_report lists all confirmed taxonomy defects in cache.py with exact category and line evidence, and no speculative or style items.
